reading_notes:
Whole and both halves were inspected line by line. The determinant recurrence's second subscript and the letter in its first argument are overinked. The handwritten operation in the rearranged coordinate recurrence resembles a division sign; the minus reading is offered only as an alternative. The sigma definition at the foot is transcribed as zeta_0, without reconciling it with scan 048's use of sigma. The small upper mark over the final zeta_-1 remains uncertain between a bar and a tilde.
Second reading compares the centre symbols in scans048,052,053: scan048 has a clear c-prime; scan052 has a small overwritten loop, closer to o in the lower pairings, marked o/c; the raised stroke on zeta_-1 is marked bar/tilde. The repeated-subject mark above the coordinate expression is retained as an uncertain parallel/equals sign instead of supplying the centre symbol again.
